notes:
Prices page: new 🌐 button opens a store page in the browser you normally use (so your saved logins and password manager work).
Pop-up and banner sales (like '15%% off with code SAVE15') are now spotted during checks and shown as a sale note next to the price. You can also type your own sale note in a store's ⚙ settings.
Your items and store links are now auto-saved to my-price-sites.csv in your data folder after every change (opens in Excel; also works with Bulk add / import). Use 📁 Saved list on the Prices page.
